text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(...I feel not a shred of drowsiness.
At this rate, sleep deprivation is inevitable.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Now that it's come to this, I shall clear my mind and banish all idle thoughts through the repetition of my techniques.
Doing so will surely grant me a restful sleep!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(First, the strike. Relax, lower my center of gravity,
and strike with the full weight of the arm itself—!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...!? What was that just now...?
Did I truly unleash that technique?
It was truly instantaneous, like lightning...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I may be on the verge of grasping the secret.
This sensation... this realm of mind...
I must make it entirely my own!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And so, Yaeno Muteki ended up staying up late after all.
